calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS unique_members_contacted
FROM fact_campaign_exposure
WHERE campaign_id = 19

SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_spending
FROM fact_sales_line AS f
WHERE f.member_key IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT member_key
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure
    WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
AND f.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
AND f.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

SELECT 
    campaign_id,
    campaign_name,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    channels,
    target_group,
    mailing_list_size,
    holdout_size
FROM dim_campaign
WHERE campaign_id = 19

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS holdout_members
FROM campaign_holdout
WHERE campaign_id = 19

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dm.member_key) AS holdout_members_contacted
FROM fact_campaign_exposure AS fce
JOIN dim_member AS dm ON fce.member_key = dm.member_key
JOIN campaign_holdout AS ch ON dm.member_id = ch.member_id
WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19 AND ch.campaign_id = 19

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT fce.member_key) AS members_contacted,
    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 2), 0) AS total_spending_eur
FROM fact_campaign_exposure AS fce
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line AS fsl ON fce.member_key = fsl.member_key 
    AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
    AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_exposures
FROM fact_campaign_exposure
WHERE campaign_id = 19

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS members_contacted,
    SUM(sales_amount) AS total_spending_eur
FROM (
    SELECT 
        DISTINCT fce.member_key,
        COALESCE(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 0) AS sales_amount
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure AS fce
    LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line AS fsl ON fce.member_key = fsl.member_key 
        AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
        AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
    WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
    GROUP BY fce.member_key
) AS member_sales

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT dm.member_id) AS unique_members,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS spending
FROM fact_sales_line AS fsl
JOIN dim_member AS dm ON fsl.member_key = dm.member_key
WHERE dm.member_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT dm2.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure AS fce
    JOIN dim_member AS dm2 ON fce.member_key = dm2.member_key
    WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
)
AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

SELECT 
    'All contacted members' AS group_label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fce.member_key) AS count,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS spending
FROM fact_campaign_exposure AS fce
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line AS fsl ON fce.member_key = fsl.member_key 
    AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
    AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Members by member_id' AS group_label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dm.member_id),
    SUM(fsl.net_amount)
FROM fact_campaign_exposure AS fce
JOIN dim_member AS dm ON fce.member_key = dm.member_key
JOIN fact_sales_line AS fsl ON dm.member_id IN (
    SELECT dm2.member_id FROM dim_member dm2
) AND fsl.member_key IN (
    SELECT member_key FROM dim_member WHERE member_id = dm.member_id
)
AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19

-- Final verification: members contacted and their spending
WITH contacted_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT member_key
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure
    WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) FROM contacted_members) AS members_contacted,
    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2), 0) AS total_spending_eur
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM contacted_members)
    AND sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
    AND sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
